canonical_title: Google DeepMind reshuffle and delayed flagship Gemini update
aliases: DeepMind teams moved into corporate Google
treatment: Repeat only for an official new Gemini release schedule, confirmed model artifact, further material DeepMind reorganization, or a major correction to the reported two-month delay and governance changes.
known_facts: Reuters reported that Google delayed its next flagship Gemini update by about two months after internal testing showed it still lagged rivals in areas including coding.
Several nontechnical DeepMind teams were moved into corporate Google after the August leadership overhaul.
Google said Koray Kavukcuoglu now has final say on major DeepMind decisions, while Demis Hassabis moved to chair with fewer management duties.
Reuters reported that Sergey Brin has pushed AI staff to prioritize Gemini and directed attention toward areas including recursive self-improvement.
reinclude_only_if: Google confirms a new flagship Gemini release date or ships the delayed model.
Google publishes a model card or benchmark artifact that materially changes the interpretation of the coding-performance delay.
Google announces further material DeepMind organizational changes or reverses the reported governance structure.
notes: Selected for the 2026-08-13 midday delta because Reuters published previously unreported internal details within the primary window.
